shared_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One clear real-world documentary photograph for a Spanish-speaking beginner learning English, full-bleed 3:2 landscape. Natural material grain, believable optics and daylight, realistic anatomy and hands. NOT an illustration, collage, split panel, cutout or app screenshot. This is a two-person conversation: who is speaking must be obvious from gaze, open mouth, posture and hand gesture alone. No speech bubbles, arrows, halos, labels, captions, logos, watermarks or readable words anywhere, including on books and paper. Both people fully visible from head to at least the knees, faces and hands inside the central safe area, with calm background and no competing people.

Both full bodies and faces are clear.
